summary.text: George Muñoz is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2009, representing District 4 in Cibola, McKinley and San Juan counties.
Muñoz chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Muñoz's occupation as businessman and a district office in Gallup.

Between sessions, Muñoz is vice chair of the Legislative Finance Committee and a member of the Public School Capital Outlay Oversight Task Force and the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee.
